decisions.reason: The 70-85 second duration change does not alter source-selection rules. Message 179 separately updates the permitted source collection, and that change is already represented.
Changing clip duration does not change the existing requirement to select moments with good hooks, and message 179 states no new hook criterion.

Message 179 separately refines substantive moment selection to lessons, stories, or real points, and that same-message change is already represented. The duration change requires no additional candidate update.
Message 179 separately refines the standalone completeness standard, and that same-message change is already represented. The 70-85 second range does not otherwise alter this requirement.
The duration range for ongoing clips does not modify or resume the deferred task-local single trial-clip assignment.
Clip duration has no necessary effect on the white-text-only and no-text-effects standards.
The new duration range does not alter the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
Changing clip duration does not alter the clean, simple visual-editing style or its prohibited visual treatments.
The 70-85 second duration constraint does not change which posted clips or metrics are tracked.
Message 179 separately establishes the roughly 4-5 clips-per-day expectation, which is already represented. The duration change does not otherwise modify the monthly approved-output requirement.
The clip-duration change does not alter the dedicated Instagram account's provisioning or purpose.
